rationale: Construct the accepted pending-snapshot discriminator through actual RawNode producers before fixing an obligation. This run tests reachability and records effects without claiming formal Evidence.
question: Can the three-voter public-entry history produce an automatic full snapshot while an older normal-entry apply batch is outstanding, and what do explicit Campaign calls do before old apply completion, after it, and after snapshot installation/completion?

feedback.answered: The driver now uses actual committed application data and returned ConfState to create the leader snapshot, compacts the producer storage, and relies on heartbeat-triggered replication fallback to generate MsgSnap. It holds receiver append work, completes the older normal apply batch first, then installs the snapshot data before returning attached storage responses. No protocol state or incoming snapshot metadata is assigned.
